_meta.purpose: Page grammar for a data-entry form: intro, one or more titled question groups, closing submit.

intro.note: Exactly one intro: the form name, an optional one-liner and the required-field convention.

groups.note: One titled section per thematic group of questions. Never stack unlabelled fields into one long column. File attachments use form.attachments — the design system has no Upload component, so that section composes one from official components.

submit.note: Exactly one closing action row: the alternative action as ghost, the submit as Brand.

rules: One narrow content column: Small (768) for every section. A form is read and filled top to bottom, not scanned.
Fields are label-above and fill the column width. Two fields share a row only when they belong together, as a ContainerHorizontal of fill-width Inputs — never a Grid.
Fields inside a fieldset sit at gap md; fieldsets and groups are separated at xl.
Mark required fields with applyProps { "Show Required Asterisk": true } and state the convention once in the intro Infotext.
Errors and hints are inline: group the field with a helper Infotext at sm inside a ContainerVertical.
Exactly one Brand action on the page, in the closing submit row. The alternative action is ghost. No mid-form Brand buttons and no per-fieldset actions.
Radio for one choice among few, checkboxes for several, Select when the option list is long.
